items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: my first lesson was from an old trombone player you call Maurice French.

ctx.x: So what I used to do, what I was doing, I bought me old trombone. Well the time I bought this trombone, I wasn't living in New Orleans. I was in Alexander. I bought the trombone in Alexander. And my first lesson was from an old trombone player you call Maurice French.
Oh yeah. He's still living up the river of the Place or something like that.
